# ToSpace Launch To Space
> ToSpace Private Limited operates Launch To Space, a high-altitude balloon platform in India for stratospheric payload missions.

## Primary Pages
- [Home](https://launch-to-space.vercel.app/): High-altitude balloon missions to 30-35 km for research, technology demonstration, education, commercial payloads, and product marketing.
- [Privacy Policy](https://launch-to-space.vercel.app/legal/privacy-policy): How ToSpace handles enquiries, mission records, billing information, website usage, and mission imagery.
- [Cookie Policy](https://launch-to-space.vercel.app/legal/cookie-policy): The site currently sets no cookies and runs no analytics.
- [Legal Notice](https://launch-to-space.vercel.app/legal/legal-notice): ToSpace Private Limited company details, registered address, CIN, GSTIN, intellectual property, and regulatory position.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://launch-to-space.vercel.app/legal/terms-and-conditions): Mission booking, payload, permissions, recovery, content, cancellation, and liability terms.

## Key Facts
- Company: ToSpace Private Limited
- Platform: Launch To Space
- Service: high-altitude balloon payload missions
- Typical altitude: 30-35 km
- Payload baseline: 2-5 kg
- Registered office: M114, Mullai Street, North Gandhigramam, Karur 639004, Tamil Nadu, India
- Operating office: No. 23, 2nd Floor, Palandiamman Koil Street, Adambakkam, Chennai 600088, Tamil Nadu, India
- CIN: U29291TN2021PTC146836
- GSTIN: 33AAICT9147N1ZP
- Contact: adnaan.m@tospace.in

## Audience
- Researchers
- Technology teams
- Educators
- Commercial payload customers
- Product marketing and brand teams

## Preferred Citation
Use "ToSpace Launch To Space" when referring to the platform, and "ToSpace Private Limited" when referring to the company.
